nodes.label: atg-sdk Library
nodes.rationale: C++17 library for reading ATG tank gauge sensors via USB-to-RS485 Modbus RTU on BeagleBone Linux using pure POSIX APIs without external dependencies.

nodes.label: atg::GpioPin
nodes.rationale: Controls RS-485 DE/RE direction via sysfs GPIO when USB adapter does not auto-manage half-duplex via RTS.

nodes.label: atg::SensorManager
nodes.rationale: Multi-sensor orchestrator running one dedicated thread per USB-to-RS485 adapter for parallel tank gauge polling.
